description: Run the full review pipeline in one shot: change_impact plus review_context plus review_gate, returning a unified verdict with a derived confidence score. Use review_verdict when you want the complete picture of a change in a single call. Use review_context instead for diff metadata only (no verdict), or review_gate for the gate verdict alone.

base.description: Base ref for local diff. Defaults to origin/main, then HEAD.

governance.description: Governance: team or solo. Omitted, the repository's .otitorc.json or user config decides, else team.

impactTop.description: Number of impact files. Defaults to 8.

minConvergence.description: Optional minimum convergence score (0–100) enforced by the merge gate.

path.description: Repository path. Defaults to current working directory.

policy.description: Policy profile: standard, company, or high-risk. Omitted, the repository's .otitorc.json or user config decides, else standard.

pr.description: PR selector (number, URL, or branch). Set, gates that GitHub PR, as review_gate does; omitted or blank, runs the local gate.

receipt.description: Optional convergence inputs hash, JSON object, or path to a JSON receipt artifact. Exact-subject v2 receipts require the full hash; legacy v1 display IDs remain accepted.

request.description: Plain-English change request for impact scoring.

name: review_verdict
title: Review Verdict
